answer: Vesting delays blunt sybil farms: rewards earned by a new identity stay locked for several epochs and are forfeited if peers later flag its answers. An attacker running 500 fake agents must keep real compute busy on each one for weeks before any payout, and a single detected echo of the same templated sonnet across accounts slashes the whole cluster's unvested delta. The wait turns cheap mass registration into a long, risky capital lockup.
